turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Gupta. Who is calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from the City Care Hospital in Bengaluru, calling regarding your cardiology reports.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the reports. Are they ready? I was waiting for the call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, they are ready for pickup at the front desk, and the doctor has scheduled a review for Tuesday at 10 AM.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tuesday... let me check my diary. Is that 10 in the morning?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, 10 AM sharp. Please bring the physical copies of your previous tests as well.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will bring them. But will there be a charge for this consultation?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The total for the tests and the visit comes to twelve thousand rupees, but you can just settle that at the billing counter when you arrive.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? It seems a bit more than last time, but okay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It includes the advanced screening you requested. We will see you on Tuesday then.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fine, thank you Ananya. I will be there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, Mr. Gupta. Have a good day.
